name: @gametabletally/web
description: The app at gametabletally.com: a scorekeeper for the game table that works with no connection.

scripts.type-check: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p e2e && tsc -p worker && tsc -p scripts
scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs && vite build --config vite.worker.config.ts && node scripts/precache.mjs
